optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Process Data Analyst, Steel Rolling Mill

professionalSummary.text: Candidate has three years of experience as a process data analyst at a steel rolling mill.
professionalSummary.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate builds and maintains the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate investigated out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure.
experienceHighlights.witness: Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate supported process change trials with the trial analyses.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate documented each analysis's limitations and hand-over conditions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation and each trial analysis.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate provided a work sample including one dashboard specification, an investigation register extract for one quarter with accepted findings, one weekly process review, and one trial record with its approval.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one dashboard specification, the investigation register extract for one quarter with the accepted findings, one weekly process review and one trial record with its approval, with the process data folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Candidate has experience with process monitoring dashboards, out-of-specification event investigations, weekly process reviews, and process change trials.
skills.witness: Process data analyst at a steel rolling mill for three years, building and maintaining the process monitoring dashboards from the mill's sensor and quality laboratory data for the two rolling lines. Investigated the out-of-specification events with the mill engineers under the investigation procedure; the investigation register records thirty-one investigations with my findings accepted by the mill engineers and the corrective actions they took. Prepared the weekly process review for the mill manager, with the reviews filed in the process data folder. Supported the process change trials with the trial analyses; the change approvals were the mill manager's, recorded on each trial record together with which analyses were mine and which the automation team's.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with process monitoring dashboards, out-of-specification event investigations, weekly process reviews, and process change trials. They do not establish the candidate's ability to explain findings to mill engineers or her attitude toward the shop floor.

decisionBoundary.statement: Qualified human review is required before any employment decision.
